strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Momentum — Paper
strategy.desc: Concentrated, high-conviction swing trades in solid large/mid-cap stocks and liquid sector ETFs. Momentum + breakout + oversold-snapback triggers. Trailing stops on every entry. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no penny stocks. Horizon 1 week to 5 years. Reigned-in profile approved by CJ 2026-06-14.
rules: Quality universe only: large/mid-cap stocks (price >$10, real revenue) and liquid ETFs (SPY/QQQ/XLK/SMH-type). No SOXL/TQQQ/crypto.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
~20% trailing stop on every entry. No naked positions ever.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16-24): reduce sizes ~25%, be choosier. RISK-OFF (VIX >24): high-conviction only.
Daily halt at −8%; monthly kill at −25%. Stand down and wait for CJ's resume signal.
Let winners run; cut losers fast; never widen a stop or limit without CJ's approval.
